raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Customers migrated to the new CRM carry numeric region codes ('01'-'04') instead of region names. silver_customers passes them through unchanged. raw_region_map gives an unambiguous code-to-name mapping, so I translate the codes in silver_customers and the gold tables follow.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.9,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_customers":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_customers AS SELECT c.customer_id, upper(coalesce(m.region_name, c.region)) AS region FROM raw_customers c LEFT JOIN raw_region_map m ON trim(c.region) = m.region_code"}}
